explanation: Requested a 5-step scan of cos(theta*) from -1 to +1 at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg for eta electroproduction. A linear 5-step scan over [-1,+1] lands exactly on the endpoints cos(theta*) = -1.0 and +1.0, which the EXCLURAD integrator cannot evaluate (integration poles). Preflight check confirmed FAIL at both endpoints and PASS at the three interior points (-0.5, 0.0, 0.5). Applied the documented, validated correction: clamped the two endpoints to +/-0.999 instead of +/-1.0, leaving the interior points unchanged. Re-ran preflight on the corrected 5-point set: all PASS. Generated one EXCLURAD input file (5 points, single chunk) using rc_mode=full (O(alpha), the validated mode) and the channel default beam energy of 6.53 GeV (CLAS12 RG-K, the campaign the eta reference data came from) with vcut=0.166 GeV^2. Other CLAS12 beam energies (10.6, 10.2 GeV) are valid alternatives but would give different radiative corrections; this run used 6.53 GeV.
